scholarships.title: Xiamen University 2027 New International Students Scholarship
scholarships.fundingLevel: Tiered tuition award with selected living stipend
scholarships.coverage: First prize waives tuition and provides a monthly stipend; second prize waives tuition; third prize waives 50% of tuition.
scholarships.applicableProgram: Eligible 2027 Xiamen University international degree programs; English-taught undergraduate programs are excluded.
scholarships.amountText: First prize: tuition waiver plus RMB 2,500/month undergraduate, RMB 3,000/month master, or RMB 3,500/month doctoral stipend; second prize: tuition waiver; third prize: 50% tuition waiver

benefitItems.label: First prize
benefitItems.note: Full tuition waiver and degree-level monthly stipend

eligibilityItems.label: Admission eligibility
eligibilityItems.value: Meet all requirements of the applicable 2027 XMU admission guide

eligibilityItems.label: Undergraduate
eligibilityItems.value: High-school qualification or above; no older than 25

eligibilityItems.label: Master
eligibilityItems.value: Bachelor qualification or above; no older than 40

eligibilityItems.label: Doctoral
eligibilityItems.value: Master qualification or above; no older than 45

applicationMaterials.label: Signed XMU New International Students Scholarship application form

applicationSteps.label: Step 1
applicationSteps.value: Apply to an eligible XMU degree program in the international applicant system

applicationSteps.label: Step 2
applicationSteps.value: Upload the signed scholarship form before April 30, 2027
